details.imageSource: Mayor Zaragoza, 16 March 1999, Wikimedia, photographer Alexandre Devil
details.summary: Spanish politician and eighth Director-General of the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO) 1987-1999
details.life: Was born 27 January 1934 in Barcelona and died 19 December 2024 in Madrid, Spain. He was the son of Federico Mayor, entrepreneur, and Juana Zaragoza. On 9 November 1956 he married María Ángeles Menéndez, pharmacist, with whom he had one daughter and two sons.
details.editors: Bob Reinalda, Kent J. Kille and Jaci L. Eisenberg
